rationales: Possible repeated setup: the two new unused-policy tests duplicate the mutate-policy, make-run, verify, and assert-error scaffold, while the new required-evidence test adds another copy of the shape already present in test_rejects_empty_blank_and_duplicate_required_evidence_policies. A helper parameterized by policy field, invalid values, run setup, and expected error would leave each test expressing only its contract-specific case.
behaviorRisks: Preserve every subTest input, the accepted-exception evidence setup in the existing test, final-gate selection, and each exact expected error string.
